exploit_name: Changing payout calculator during active drawing causes loss of unclaimed winnings
description: Swapping payout calculator during settlement uses new calculator's logic instead of the one active when tickets were purchased.
root_cause: Swapping payout calculator during settlement uses new calculator's logic instead of the one active when tickets were purchased.
fix_description: Store active payout calculator in drawing state when initializeJackpot() is called.
notes: Users receive incorrect winnings based on unintended payout rules.
